title: Nacreous Cloud
content: Laurent Alquier, a connoisseur of unusual atmospheric phenomena, sent me this photo from his collection, with the following comment:This is a case of Nacreous Cloud, horizontal rainbow diffused throughout a cloud layer. Apparently, these can be seen in northern countries closer to the pole.More on nacreous or polar stratospheric clouds,link.This photo is from the website Dark Roasted Blend,link
